sloka: तस्य राक्षसराजस्य त्रस्ता कुम्भीनसी तदा ।तां समुत्थापयामास न भेतव्यमिति ब्रुवन् ।। ७.२५.४० ॥
transliteration: tasya rākṣasarājasya trastā kumbhīnasī tadā ।tāṁ samutthāpayāmāsa na bhetavyamiti bruvan ।। 7.25.40 ॥

translations.english: Then, Kumbhinasi, frightened by that king of Rakshasas, made her rise, saying, "You should not be afraid."
